notes.title: Major Map, Biome, and Base Deco Update is Out Now!
notes.notes: [h2]Hey [i]Ruins To Fortress[/i] players![/h2][p][b]Ruins to Fortress[/b] is stepping up with its biggest update yet! After the successful Early Access release in December and months of technical fine-tuning, version [b]0.5.0[/b] brings a massive overhaul to the core gameplay of this 2D survival title.[/p][p]The update consists of multiple major expansions. With [i][b]New Horizons[/b][/i], the game world has been reimagined: for the first time, players will explore procedurally generated maps, featuring a completely revamped biome system. Eight diverse biomes – from icy tundras to scorching deserts – introduce fresh challenges and strategic depth. Instead of one large island, players will now navigate multiple islands, and even the size of the map is customizable.[/p][p]Looking to make your base feel more like home? The [b][i]Homestead[/i][/b] update adds 20 new decorative items, including functional clocks, atmospheric light sources like lava lamps and torches, houseplants, and even a working radio. Every base can now become a truly personal space.[/p][p]On the gameplay side, version 0.5.0 introduces dangerous [b]underground bunkers[/b] for daring players to explore. In addition, new [b]destructible NPC bases[/b] offer fresh PvE opportunities and valuable loot. And to top it off, a wide range of [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] have been implemented – including a fully redesigned building system with snap-to-grid functionality, visible snap points, a reworked clan manager, and a handy [b]minimap[/b].[/p][p][b]Note: Save games from the old static map version are not compatible with the new version, and vice versa.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Map System[/h2][list][*][p]Seed-based worlds: every game generates a unique map unless you enter a custom seed[/p][/*][*][p]Manually choose seed and map size[/p][/*][*][p]More detailed map options unlock after testing[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Biomes[/h2][p]Tundra · Steppe · Forest · Meadows · Rocklands · City · Savanna · Desert[/p][hr][/hr][h2]New Features and Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]New tree types[/p][/*][*][p]New monument: Underground bunker[/p][/*][*][p]Destructible NPC bases you can loot[/p][/*][*][p]Grenades are now bouncier[/p][/*][*][p]Player drones and boats now consume fuel[/p][/*][*][p]Drones can move up and down using the jump key (Space)[/p][/*][*][p]Minimap shows other clan members, your bed, last death, biomes, and monuments; areas unlock as you explore[/p][/*][*][p]Torchlight and headlamps now shine higher and lower vertically, making it easier to spot boats in the water[/p][/*][*][p]Day/Night Cycle: Night time is now 4x faster than daytime[/p][/*][*][p]Rain now has a minimum cooldown of 30 minutes before it can appear again[/p][/*][*][p]If a player gets stuck for example between a npc or player base, the game will try to spawn an "emergency boat" nearby after a couple of minutes[/p][/*][*][p]The nuke explosion will only affect 30% of the area within its blast radius. Player bases and clan bases are protected and won't be destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]Improved sorting for craftable items and buildings, now color-coded to highlight commonly used items[/p][/*][*][p]Item and notes.title: Game Patch Notes - Version 0.3.1
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thank you for your invaluable feedback. Your input has been crucial in improving the game. We're excited to share this patch, which addresses several issues and introduces some changes.

Special thanks to everyone on Steam Discussions and Discord for testing, reporting bugs, and suggesting improvements. Your support means the world to us!

[b]Bug Fixes / Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] When painting the back wall, the game now highlights areas where painting is possible.
[*] Fixed an item duplication bug where quickly moving an item from storage with right-click and closing the inventory at the right moment would create a duplicate.
[*] Increased the vertical building range of Workbench 3 to allow for taller structures.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Big Game Hunter" achievement was not being awarded.
[*] Fences can now be placed outside of the workbench range.
[*] Fixed an issue where the workbench range and no-build area were larger than intended.
[*] The despawn animation for used boats is now faster.
[*] Dropped items now despawn after 5 minutes instead of 3.
[*] The "Repair Item" button now disappears properly after repairing.

[/list]
We're continually working to improve the game based on your feedback. Thank you for your ongoing support and patience as we refine the experience.

Happy gaming!

Markus & Simon

notes.title: Defense Items Update - Version 0.3.0
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

Version 0.3.0 introduces an overhaul of the satoshi mining system, adjustments to electric systems, and exciting new defense items to Ruins To Fortress. Share your feedback in the comments or on Discord, let us know what you love and what could be improved!

[b]Highlights[/b]

[b]New Defense Items:[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/2e5ab067dc0d229f4483f388ce01f0e248140c75.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Death Spike: A sharp spike trap that injures anyone who steps on it.
[*] Iron Bite: A strong bear trap with reinforced metal teeth, built to wound enemies.
[*] Havoc Mine: A pressure-activated explosive that shreds unlucky players who trigger it.
[*] Sand Wall: A durable sandbag barrier that shields against bullets and explosions.
[*] Bastion: A fortified turret platform that can hold different guns (Pistol, Shotgun, Uzi, AK-47) for defense. Requires electricity and the right ammo to function.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/86f82f05ca19acc2d2b652dd3dbcf053aee487ed.png[/img]
[b]Satoshi Mining system overhaul and Electric systems adjustements:[/b] 
The Satoshi mining system is a great way to earn in-game currency, and it now unlocks earlier than before, along with many electric items. Satoshis will no longer drop as often. You will need to mine them, grow crops, or sell items at vending machines to earn them.

To make power management easier, essential electric items for building the grid have been moved from Workbench 3 to Workbench 1. Solar panels now generate more electricity, and batteries store more energy, making your power system more efficient.

[b]Mining System Overview [/b]
The mining system lets players earn rewards by running mining racks. Each mining rack contributes to the global hashrate, which determines the difficulty and reward distribution.  
[list]
[*] Hashrate & Difficulty: The system adjusts difficulty based on total mining power, keeping rewards balanced.  
[*] Rewards: Players receive satoshis based on their mining contribution, with bonuses for consistency.
[*] Bonuses & Achievements:Mining streaks and catch-up mechanics boost earnings, and players can unlock achievements by accumulating rewards.  
[*] Live Updates: You’ll receive chat messages updating you on bonuses, milestones, and mining streaks, helping you stay informed.  
[/list]
Keep your miners running, manage power to earn the best rewards!

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where repairing items inside containers, such as chests, was not working.
[*] Fixed an issue where, after saving and loading the game, NPCs would not spawn correctly if the in-game days had progressed beyond two. Now, the correct number of NPCs will appear based on the selected difficulty.
[*] Fixed item stacking bugs for produced items in planter boxes and other containers.
[*] Added new console command "dlc_reload" to restore missing DLC items if they were not granted correctly
[/list]

[b]Upcoming Features in the Pipeline[/b]
[list]
[*] Explore the new Bunker and Silo System - discover underground bases and hidden loot
[*] Raid NPC bases packed with valuable resources and equipment
[*] Experience bigger maps with more room to explore and build
[*] New biomes and areas to discover, each with unique challenges
[*] Battle challenging new NPCs and epic boss encounters
[*] Full mod support to customize your game experience
[*] New items
[*] Create your perfect character with the new character creator
[/list]

[b]Don't miss out on our Survivors Pack DLC or the stunning Serpent's Dawn Skin Pack.[/b]

Happy gaming!

Markus & Simon

[u]Join our community on Discord and test Ruins To Fortress on Steam.[/u]

[b]Follow us To Stay Notified[/b]

notes.title: Major Update - Version 0.2.0
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

Version 0.2.0 introduces exciting updates to game mechanics and resource management. Share your feedback in the comments or on Discord, let us know what you love and what could be improved!

[b]Highlights[/b]

[b]Difficulty Settings:[/b] A dropdown menu now controls overall gameplay settings, replacing the day/night cycle and outlaw disable options. Choose from the following:

[b]Easy:[/b] No raids, always daytime, stable resources.
[b]Normal:[/b] Raids from Day 2, gradual resource decline.
[b]Hard:[/b] Raids from Day 1, tougher raids, faster resource decline, no respawns or saves.
[b]Hardcore:[/b] Raids from Day 1, tougher raids, one life, resource scarcity, no respawns or saves.

[b]Example for Normal Difficulty:[/b]
Day 1: Peaceful exploration
Day 2: The bear raid begins, resources start declining a bit and aggressive NPCs begin to spawn.
Day 3+: NPC raids intensify with grenades.
Day 5+: Raids include C4, making survival even tougher
Day 6+...

A detailed explanation can be found in our wiki.

Raids now start at moonrise, with distinct music playing depending on whether a raid is triggered or it's a peaceful night. The bear attack from placing raw meat in a campfire has been removed, along with the raid triggered by defeating the red soldier near the bunker. [b]Raids are now predictable, providing a clear rhythm and game loop.[/b]

We hope that the combination of PvP and PvE game modes, along with the variety of difficulty options, offers something for everyone.

[b]New Vending Machine System:[/b] Vending machines are now categorized into Crafting, Food, and Ammunition, making them easier to use and navigate.

[b]Resource Management:[/b] Adjusted loot drops, crafting materials, resource costs, and stack sizes to balance loot and prevent inventory overflow. 

[b]Weapon Upgrade:[/b] Improved firing angles make it easier to hit targets from higher or lower positions.

[b]We are truly excited to hear your thoughts on the changes and the direction we’re taking with the game. Your feedback is incredibly valuable, so please share your impressions with us in the comments, on Discord, or in the Steam Forums![/b]

The game will continue to have the three main modes: PvP (Player vs. Player), PvE (Player vs. Environment), and Deathmatch. These will stay in the game to let players choose how they want to play, whether it's teaming up, fighting other players, or competing in all-out battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/a65b9e8892d8a177c7bedd13b785f82d14415649.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
- Save game limits can now be set individually
- Peaceful nights and raid events now feature appropriate soundtracks
- Highwalls can no longer be placed too close together
- Placement of large items like beds and large wood boxes is now easier, even near fuse boxes
- Boat Interaction: Entering boats near other items now works as intended
- Fixed translation error when hammer breaks
- Reduced durability wear for tools and weapons
- Balanced weapon stats: pistols are stronger, arrows slightly weaker
- Resolved NPC bug with floating chickens and wandering behavior
- Clearing leftover buildings and floating items better.

[b]Reminder:[/b]
-The free early adopter shirt skin drop will no longer be available after this update.
-All Xmas DLC skins, like Santa’s Cap and Evergreen Shirt, will not drop anymore until next Christmas.
-The Xmas Tree will no longer be craftable.

Don't miss out on our Survivors Pack DLC or the stunning Serpent's Dawn Skin Pack.

Happy gaming!

Markus & Simon

notes.title: The Road Ahead - Release, Roadmap and Pricing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716333/ae66cb8403c94d10f9e146412761d6a93cdecf38.gif[/img]

First of all, we want to thank you for 5000 wishlist additions! 
This means a lot to us and motivates us to keep going. The Open World Survival Crafting Fest and the Steam Next Fest were successful promotional events that brought us many new players who tested our demo. This resulted in many bug fixes, especially in so-called edge cases, meaning errors in situations that rarely occur. We also received many improvement suggestions, which we have discussed both internally and with you.

Even though we had a specific internal plan, many goals for the future were still vague. Therefore, we have, together with you, determined which feature packages should be completed before the release and created a roadmap. We also considered how we could monetize our game to ensure continued development.

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]

[h3]Electricity Update[/h3]
- Implement power generators
- Electric lights
- Satoshi miners
- Some more gadgets

[h3]Animal Taming Update[/h3]
- Adding tameable creatures with unique abilities

[h3]Raid Kits Update[/h3]
- Create specialized equipment sets for different raiding strategies
- Balance raid kits for fair and exciting gameplay

[h3]Cosmetic Skins Update[/h3]
- Design a variety of skins for characters and equipment

[h3]Multiple Maps and Biomes Update[/h3]
- Develop distinct maps, each featuring unique challenges
- Create diverse biomes

All added features will not be feature-complete but will lay the foundation for more content to be added. The scheduled release is Friday, the 13th of December. What could go wrong?

[h1]Early Access and Pricing[/h1]
After nearly two years of development, we will have implemented a large portion of the planned features and plan to go into Early Access. We see this step as essential to improve the quality and quantity of content. Before the release, we will release a post-release roadmap that will outline the path to version 1.0 and hint at what content is planned afterward. Since PvE content is very time-consuming to develop, we have decided to postpone much of it until next year and focus on PvP content until the release.

As an indie game studio, it is very difficult to release a multiplayer game because you compete not only with other small indie studios but also with large studios with major titles. Most large multiplayer games are therefore free and are financed through expensive skins, pay-to-win elements, pointless in-game currencies, and unnecessary battle passes.
And believe us, we hate these mechanisms as much as you do and still fall for them often enough. That is why we have decided on a model that will be attractive to you and still cover the development costs.
We will start Early Access with a Free to Play model. Additionally, there will be a DLC that will unlock additional non-gameplay relevant content. This will include unlocking skins and the ability to host additional maps or game modes - joining a server with additional content will still be free. With a low, fair price, we want to ensure that as many players as possible can afford this upgrade and support us.

So far, these are the current plans. Of course, these can still change, so please don't be mad at us if they do.
What is your opinion on this?

Thank you for reading.
